subject: fix(tabs): make code tabs keyboard and screen reader accessible
plain: Code tabs are real tabs now. Tab reaches the strip, Left and Right arrows switch the language on every group at once, and screen readers hear a tab list with the selected tab.

steps: Scroll to 'Index a single document' and click in the paragraph 'Let's see how we can add a new document to a collection.' just above the first code tab strip
Press Tab once
Press ArrowRight twice, then ArrowLeft once, then click 'Go' with the mouse
try.expect_head: Tab lands on 'JavaScript' with a green inset focus ring. Each arrow selects the next tab at once with no Enter, the pill jumps without gliding, and the strip stays at the same height on screen while every other group on the page switches too. The arrows end on PHP. The mouse click on Go glides the pill over about 300ms.
try.expect_base: Tab skips the strip and lands on the hidden code copy button. Arrows scroll the page. There is no keyboard way to change the language.

gate.setup: Fresh context, no localStorage. Load and wait for hydration (the pill `[data-copy-tabs] > [aria-hidden=true]` exists in the first strip).
gate.measure: const strip = document.querySelector('[data-copy-tabs]'). Read strip.tagName and strip.getAttribute('role'). For each strip.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]') read tagName, aria-selected, tabIndex, id and aria-controls. For each aria-controls id, read document.getElementById(id).getAttribute('role') and aria-labelledby. Cross-check with page.accessibility.snapshot() for a tablist node.
gate.base_expected: strip is a UL with role null. No [role=tab] children (tabs are LI, tabIndex -1, no aria-selected). Panels (.tab-content) have no role.
gate.head_expected: strip is a DIV with role=tablist holding 10 BUTTON role=tab (9 languages plus 'Other Languages'). Exactly one has aria-selected=true and tabIndex 0 ('JavaScript'), the other nine tabIndex -1. Each aria-controls resolves to a role=tabpanel whose aria-labelledby equals that tab's id.

judgement: The tablist is hand-rolled, not reka-ui Tabs. reka cost 83 to 133ms per sync click at 4x CPU, kept a stale tab stop across synced groups and broke ids on 'Other Languages'. Home and End are deliberately not handled, so they still scroll the page, and the 00-README guard that says Home/End work in tabs is wrong. A clicked tab keeps focus (platform default). Click, scroll away, then an arrow key jumps the page back to the strip, which matches Radix.
regression_watch: Sync across groups with the clicked strip held in place (strip 13 of 25 on documents.html stays at y 300 to 301 while scrollY moves). The phone nav must not hide or reveal on arrow picks, which relies on the useNavHidden change in this commit that ignores defaultPrevented keydowns. Saved language (localStorage default-tab) and ?languages= links. data-copy-tabs and data-copy-active-tab stay on the strip for Copy Markdown. The 'Other Languages' pre became a Tab stop (tabindex 0). 9a961159 and eb4869bf refine the keyboard logic, check the final state.

subject: fix(tabs): leave one-tab strips out of the tab order

gate.setup: Fresh context. Load and wait for hydration.
gate.measure: For every `[data-copy-tabs]` whose children without aria-hidden number exactly 1, read that child's tabIndex. Then focus the first strip's selected tab and press Tab 15 times, logging document.activeElement each step, and check no stop is inside `[data-copy-tabs='["JSON"]']`.
gate.base_expected: Every lone LI has tabIndex -1 (no tab on base is focusable at all). No Tab stop inside a JSON strip.
gate.head_expected: Every lone [role=tab] has tabIndex -1 and is never a Tab stop. Each multi-tab strip still has exactly one tab with tabIndex 0. Guard that holds on both builds.

judgement: A lone tab is treated as a label (owner's call) but keeps role=tab, so a screen reader in browse mode still reads it as a selected tab, 1 of 1.
regression_watch: Multi-tab strips must keep their single Tab stop.

subject: fix(tabs): scroll a keyboard-focused tab clear of the strip edges
plain: When a keyboard user tabs into a code tab strip that was swiped sideways, the focused tab scrolls fully into view instead of sitting half under the edge fade.

steps: Use a keyboard, not touch. Scroll the first code tab strip sideways until 'JavaScript' is half hidden under the left edge fade (or set the first `[data-copy-tabs]` scrollLeft to 40)
Click in the paragraph just above the strip, then press Tab
try.expect_head: The strip jumps without gliding so 'JavaScript' is fully visible with its focus ring, at least 16px clear of both strip edges.

gate.setup: Fresh context (keyboard). Wait for hydration. const strip = document.querySelector('[data-copy-tabs]'). Set strip.scrollLeft = 40. Click the paragraph above it.
gate.measure: Press Tab, wait 2 frames. const a = document.activeElement.getBoundingClientRect(), s = strip.getBoundingClientRect(). Check a.left >= s.left + 16 && a.right <= s.right - 16 and document.activeElement.matches('[role=tab]').
gate.base_expected: activeElement is not a tab (it's the code copy button or later).
gate.head_expected: activeElement is the 'JavaScript' tab and lies at least 16px inside both strip edges (handoff measured 24px before 11126d9b narrowed the padding to 16).

judgement: Owner asked to follow Emil's rule that keyboard focus never lands off screen. A first attempt with scroll-px-6 was replaced by reusing the strip's centring on keyboard focusin.
regression_watch: Mouse clicks still glide the strip into view, gated by prefers-reduced-motion. Keyboard picks never glide. This commit also reworked the glide check from 5ed71446. 11126d9b later set the strip padding (the fade inset this uses) to 16px, so check the last tab ('Other Languages') clears the right fade at 390.

subject: perf(tabs): render code tabs on the server

gate.setup: Part (a) is curl only. Part (b): fresh context, no saved language, cold cache, PerformanceObserver for 'layout-shift' registered with buffered true via addInitScript.
gate.measure: (a) curl -s <origin>/docs/30.2/api/search.html | grep -o 'role="tablist"' | wc -l. (b) load in Playwright at 390x844 and at 1440x900, wait 5s, sum value of layout-shift entries without hadRecentInput.
gate.base_expected: (a) 0, the groups are absent from server HTML (ClientOnly). (b) CLS about 0.56 at 390 and 0.43 at 1440 (handoff 01, measured on master).

A saved non-first language swaps in after mount and can still shift the page (CLS 0.071 on search.html at 1440 with Shell saved, 0 with Python). The server fills only the shown panel and the rest fill right after mount, adding about 4 to 7KB gzipped per page (documents +7.3KB, search +4.4KB). docsearch.config.js now excludes [role=tablist] and [role=tabpanel] from records, verified by emulating the scraper, never by a real run.
regression_watch: No hydration mismatch warning in the console with localStorage default-tab=Shell on the prod build. After mount every [role=tabpanel] has content (Copy Markdown, find-in-page). Hash landings with a saved language (h3 at 121, h4 at 182, phone h2 at 48). Search records on the next scrape. settleAnchor.ts only had its comment changed.
